description: Khurais Oil Processing Facility Saudi Arabia February 4, 2017 The Khurais Oil Field added 1.2 million barrels of oil per day to Saudi Arabia’s production capacity when it came on-line in 2009. The field’s Central Production Facility, located northwest of Riyadh, separates wet crude oil into stabilized crude, sour gas, and natural gas liquids.
